name: dim_customer
comment: Silver-layer mirror of customers_master used as a stable join target during transformation; carries the same conformed customer attributes.

columns.name: hash_key
columns.comment: Deterministic hash of this record's natural/business key, generated during ingestion. Used internally for deduplication and change-detection; not a business attribute and should not be used for reporting.

columns.name: customer_master_id
columns.comment: Unique, conformed customer identifier; matches customers_master.customer_master_id.

columns.name: customer_name
columns.comment: Customer's full name as recorded on their most recent order.

columns.name: email
columns.comment: Customer's email address, used as a primary matching key during identity resolution.

columns.name: phone
columns.comment: Customer's phone number, used as a secondary matching key during identity resolution.

columns.name: city
columns.comment: Customer's city, from their most recent known address.

columns.name: state
columns.comment: Customer's state/region, from their most recent known address.

columns.name: country
columns.comment: Customer's country, from their most recent known address.

columns.name: signup_date
columns.comment: Date the customer's account/profile was first created in any channel.

columns.name: acquisition_channel
columns.comment: The sales channel through which this customer was first acquired.

columns.name: rn
columns.comment: Row number assigned per natural key by the ingestion pipeline (partitioned by business key, ordered by recency). rn = 1 identifies the current/latest version of a record when historized duplicates exist in this table.

columns.name: insert_timestamp
columns.comment: UTC timestamp when this record was first loaded into the silver layer. Reflects pipeline load time, not a business event time.

columns.name: modified_timestamp
columns.comment: UTC timestamp when this record was last updated by the ingestion pipeline. Reflects pipeline processing time, not a business event time.

columns.name: source_name
columns.comment: Name of the upstream source system or source file this record was ingested from. Used for data lineage and troubleshooting, not for business analysis.

columns.name: is_deleted
columns.comment: Soft-delete flag set by the ingestion pipeline when the source record was removed or tombstoned upstream. Rows where this is TRUE should normally be excluded from business reporting.
